marketSummary: Indian equity benchmarks snapped a two-day winning run on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, as the RBI Monetary Policy Committee unexpectedly hiked the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening' to curb oil-driven inflation risks. The Nifty 50 dropped 173.05 points (-0.76%) to 22,603.05, testing key support at 22,600, while the BSE Sensex lost 429.11 points (-0.59%) to settle at 72,638.70. With Brent crude spiking above $101/bbl and FII outflows continuing, rate-sensitive segments like auto, real estate, and NBFCs faced sharp liquidation, while private and PSU banking majors showed relative resilience.
dailyFocus: Protect capital around the critical 22,600 Nifty pivot; avoid buying into damaged rate-sensitives and concentrate swing exposure strictly on high-conviction momentum pockets like retail leaders and defence heavyweights benefiting from execution clearance.

news.headline: Kalyan Jewellers Rallies on 26% Q2 Revenue Growth and Zero Non-GML Debt
news.summary: Kalyan Jewellers gained nearly 4% on October 7 after reporting consolidated Q2 revenue growth over 26% YoY, driven by 27% growth in domestic operations and 20% same-store sales growth despite a tough Navratri base. The company also monetized a non-core land parcel for ₹86 crore and eliminated its non-GML debt entirely.
news.impact: Strong volume breakout and outperformance relative to jewellery peers set up a potential base continuation toward ₹570–₹580.

news.headline: Nifty Slips Below 22,650 as Crude Tops $101 and FII Outflows Exceed ₹2,960 Crore
news.summary: The Nifty 50 surrendered 173 points to end at 22,603.05 on Wednesday, dragged by elevated Brent crude at $101.60/bbl and unabated FII selling of ₹2,961.30 crore in the prior session. Technical analysts highlight that holding above the critical 22,600 support is vital to prevent an extended correction toward 22,200.
news.impact: Warns swing traders against aggressive long breakout positioning unless the benchmark reclaims 22,750 on expanding breadth.

news.headline: GE Aerospace Delivers 4 More F404 Engines to HAL for LCA Tejas Mk-1A Delivery Target
news.summary: GE Aerospace confirmed the shipment of four additional F404-IN20 turbofan jet engines to Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, following three engines delivered in August. The deliveries support HAL's commitment to deliver 10 Tejas Mk-1A fighters by March 2027, alleviating key supply-chain bottleneck concerns.
news.impact: Removes a major program execution overhang, bolstering base breakout odds as multi-quarter revenue visibility solidifies.

news.headline: RBI Hikes Repo Rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, Shifts Stance to 'Calibrated Tightening'
news.summary: In an unexpected pivot on October 7, 2026, the RBI MPC raised the policy repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%—its first hike since February 2023—and shifted stance to 'calibrated tightening' citing crude oil over $100 and elevated inflation risks. FY27 inflation projection was raised to 5.2%, while growth forecast was lifted to 7.1%.
news.impact: Triggers immediate multiple compression across rate-sensitive high-beta sectors while shifting swing focus to balance-sheet leaders.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Jumps on 24.7% Q2 Loan Growth, CEO Approval and Brokerage Upgrades
news.summary: Kotak Bank emerged as the top Nifty gainer on October 7, rising nearly 2% accompanied by a 12.9% expansion in derivatives open interest. Growth was supported by Q2 provisional net advances jumping 24.7% YoY to ₹5.77 lakh crore, formal RBI approval for Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO, and an upgrade to Buy from HSBC with a ₹520 target.
news.impact: Defies broad index weakness via institutional accumulation; clearing ₹442 opens the path toward retesting ₹453 record highs.

news.headline: Titan Drops 4.5% as Q2 Domestic Jewellery Growth of 21% Misses Street Expectations
news.summary: Titan Company was the biggest laggard on the Nifty 50 on October 7, tumbling over 4% to an intraday low of ₹4,334.90. While overall consumer sales rose 25%, domestic jewellery revenue grew 21% YoY, missing consensus projections of 25–27% due to consumer pushback from record gold prices and calendar shifts into Q3.
news.impact: Triggers a breakdown below short-term moving averages, invalidating long setups until clear support base forms around ₹4,300.

news.headline: Trent Q2 Standalone Revenue Surges 23% YoY; Zudio Hits 1,000-Store Milestone
news.summary: Trent released a stellar Q2 provisional business update reporting a 23% YoY surge in standalone revenue to ₹5,788 crore, accelerating from 18.5% growth in Q1. The value-fashion arm Zudio officially crossed the 1,000-store mark, adding 17 stores in Q2 and 36 across H1 FY27. Detailed Q2 financial results are scheduled for October 29, 2026.
news.impact: High-volume surge above consolidation resistance marks an exceptional momentum setup targeting continuation runs toward ₹2,950–₹3,000.

news.headline: Motilal Oswal Picks BEL as Top Defence Bet on ₹13 Lakh Crore Approvals Pipeline
news.summary: Motilal Oswal reiterated Bharat Electronics as its premier defence pick, pointing to cumulative Defence Acquisition Council approvals of ₹13 lakh crore across FY25 to FY27 YTD. Although Q2 ordering was quiet, massive finalizations are anticipated over H2 FY27 including QRSAM and missile systems. BEL trades around ₹380-₹385 in an accumulation range.
news.impact: Re-accumulation around key support provides asymmetric swing risk-reward prior to major defence contract announcements.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Advances Commercial Green Fleet and Global Repair Joint Ventures
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard is actively executing on major international initiatives, including its ₹1,800-crore international ship repair joint venture with DP World's Drydocks World and commercial vessel programs with CMA CGM and Svitzer. European battery maker AYK Energy contracted equipment supply on October 6 for four electric tugs under construction at CSL.
news.impact: Price is maintaining tight consolidation above the ₹1,500 zone; await fresh commercial milestone contracts to trigger a breakout toward ₹1,650.

news.headline: HAL Expands Propulsion Base with ₹218-Cr Shakti Engine Line and Buys Out HATSOFF
news.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh laid the foundation stone for HAL's new ₹218-crore Shakti engine line at Koraput, Odisha on October 6, targeting an annual capacity of 100 engines for indigenous Dhruv and Prachand helicopters. Concurrently, HAL executed an agreement to acquire CAE Canada's 50% stake in the HATSOFF simulator JV at nil consideration.
news.impact: Increases indigenous value addition and high-margin MRO share, offering steady support for mid-term swing bases.

news.headline: CG Power Rebounds 3.4% to ₹912 on Heavy Delivery as Transformer Unit Head Resigns
news.summary: CG Power rose 3.37% on October 6 to ₹912 with delivery volumes accounting for 43.3% of total trades. In an exchange disclosure, the company notified that Ajay Jain, VP of the Transformer Business, stepped down effective September 30 due to personal obligations. Power gear demand across domestic and export markets remains robust.
news.impact: Strong accumulation off the ₹885 swing floor points to constructive base behavior, with a push above ₹920 required for trigger confirmation.
